reported_time_is: the published whole minute, in seconds, not the model's float (docs/s3-decision-report.md)

refused.label: band15min_pass-03
reasons: no start door recorded, so the walk's origin is unknown
the destination reached is not recorded
where the walk ended is not recorded, so the shop reached is identified by name only and a name does not identify a shop
the route walked is not on the record
the record does not say whether the route walked could be identified
the duration is recorded as not timed, so it is an estimate

what_this_does_not_establish: Admissibility is not agreement. A refused walk is not evidence the product was right, and an admissible one that does not trip either limb is not evidence that it was: E3 returns FAILED or UNVERIFIED and never 'supported'.
